items.description: A page (slide, layout, master or notes page) and its elements and properties.

notesMaster.description: The notes master of the presentation.

objectId.description: The unique object ID of the page (slide, layout, master or notes page).

pageType.description: The type of the page, e.g. "SLIDE", "LAYOUT", "MASTER" or "NOTES".

pageElements.description: The page elements on the page (shapes, images, tables, lines, videos, groups, etc.) with their size, transform and content.

pageProperties.description: The page-specific properties such as the background fill and color scheme.

slideProperties.description: Properties specific to a slide, such as its layout/master references and notes page.

layoutProperties.description: Properties specific to a layout, such as its display name and master reference.

masterProperties.description: Properties specific to a master page, such as its display name.

notesProperties.description: Properties specific to a notes page, such as the speaker notes object ID.

Presentation.description: A Google Slides presentation with its slides, page elements, masters and layouts.

items.description: A Google Slides presentation ID to sync. Example: "1XFaFcivdWdl-Em5A8HC0_Oua7fSWpw-MR_QDj1AHsPI".

presentationIds.description: The list of Google Slides presentation IDs to fetch and emit as sync records.

SyncMetadata_google_slides_presentations.description: Connection metadata that supplies the Google Slides presentation IDs this sync should fetch.
